labeling_rule: expected_pages = the pages a technician must see to answer. A case counts as a hit if ANY of them is retrieved/cited. Keep lists short (1-3) or hit@k becomes meaningless.

cases.symptom: Furnace fires up, runs a few minutes, then the burners shut off. The display shows 33.
cases.note: p54 status code table (33 = main limit circuit open); p61 'Check Main Limit Switch'.

cases.symptom: Furnace is locked out and won't heat. Status shows 13.
cases.note: p54: 13 = limit lockout, switch open >3 min.

cases.symptom: No heat. I can hear the inducer fan and see the igniter glow orange but the burners never light. Code 34.
cases.note: p54: 34 = ignition fault; p65 burners/flame sensor cleaning; p69 trial-for-ignition / flame proving sequence.

cases.symptom: Furnace tried to light several times and then just stopped trying. Display reads 14.
cases.note: p54: 14 = ignition lockout after 4 tries; p69 explains lockout reset (3 hours or power interrupt).

cases.symptom: Inducer motor starts but nothing else happens and it never ignites. Code 31 on the board.
cases.note: p54: 31 = main pressure switch open; p66 flushing collector box / drainage (blocked drain is the usual cause). REVIEW: add p68 if you think sequence of op matters.

cases.symptom: Furnace is completely dead, no heat and no fan. The display shows 24.
cases.note: p54: 24 = fuse fault; p62 says code 24.1 when the fuse needs replacing.

cases.symptom: Control light is flashing rapidly and the furnace will not operate at all. It says 10.1.
cases.note: p26 & p62: status 10.1 / rapid flash = L1 polarity / power wiring problem. REVIEW.

cases.symptom: Very weak airflow out of the vents and the house takes forever to heat. How often should the filter be cleaned or replaced?
Burners light for two or three seconds and then go out, and it keeps repeating.
cases.note: Classic dirty flame sensor. p65 'Cleaning Burners and Flame Sensor'; p69 2-sec flame proving period.

cases.symptom: There's water pooling on the floor under the furnace.
cases.note: p66 flushing collector box and drainage; p67 cleaning condensate drain and trap.

cases.symptom: Calling for heat, the inducer runs but the igniter never glows.
cases.note: p66 'Servicing Hot Surface Igniter'. REVIEW: add p69 (igniter warm-up)?

cases.symptom: Loud rattling and vibration from the blower when the fan runs.
cases.note: p64 'Blower Motor and Wheel Maintenance'; p65 blower wheel set-screw figure.

cases.symptom: The problem comes and goes. How do I see the fault codes the furnace has recorded?
cases.note: p62 'Retrieving Stored Fault Codes'. p54 (Flt menu: last 7 faults) also acceptable.

cases.symptom: Furnace shut down and I was told a rollout switch tripped. There's a reset button near the burners.
cases.note: p55: manual reset limit switch in burner box for flame rollout; p65 figure shows flame rollout switch location.

cases.symptom: The furnace seems to overheat and cycles on and off quickly. What should the temperature rise be?
How do I run the built-in component self test to check the inducer, igniter and blower?
cases.note: p55 'To Begin Component Self-Test' and Table 22 Test Sequence.
